definitions.tooltipZh: 工蜂采集效率+30%。

基础工蜂单位。可采集晶矿与瓦斯，变异为建筑。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面单位。</c>

localizations.value: 该工蜂获得永久隐形能力。

localizations.value: 该工蜂变异/建造速度大幅提升（变异过程仍会死亡）。

localizations.value: 该工蜂每次采矿额外带回1晶体矿。

localizations.value: 该工蜂每次采气额外带回1瓦斯。

definitions.tooltipZh: 黄昏之翼需在"唤醒虫祖"（泽鲁斯1）解锁。

definitions.tooltipZh: 超视距范围杀伤炮兵，需侦察单位辅助定位。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面单位。</c>

localizations.value: 超视距范围杀伤炮兵，需侦察单位辅助定位。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面单位。</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 电磁野兽周身磁场逆转时引发内爆，将5范围内非英雄地面单位拽向爆炸中心并短暂眩晕。

localizations.value: 电磁野兽周身磁场逆转时引发内爆，将5范围内非英雄地面单位拽向爆炸中心并短暂眩晕。

definitions.tooltipZh: 减慢空中单位15%的攻速和移速

localizations.value: 减慢空中单位15%的攻速和移速

获得10点最大护盾值和每秒2点护盾恢复。

definitions.tooltipZh: 人族步兵与建筑升级设施。<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">解锁：</c><n/>- SCV建造导弹塔<n/>- SCV建造感应塔<n/>- 指挥中心升级行星要塞

definitions.tooltipZh: 隐形单位，仅能被侦测器或特定效果发现。<n/><n/><c val="f078ff">能量消耗：<d ref="-1 * (Behavior,Enshrouded,Modification.VitalRegenArray[2] + Unit,Mesmer,EnergyRegenRate)" precision="1"/>点/秒。</c>

<s val="Coop_Prestige_Tooltip">MISSION TIPS</s><n/>Try to keep your reinforcements alive, but don't stress it too much.<n/><n/>All timers have been removed, so take the second phase at your own speed.
蒙斯克的帝国驻地会自动训练和补充基础步兵小队。<n/><n/>皇家兵营、工厂和星港可生产皇家卫队单位，这些单位消耗大量瓦斯，但会随着等级提升而变强。<n/><n/>战争恶犬孵化场会产出受控的虫族单位，由AI控制。<n/><n/>最后，他还能使用各种强大的超级单位。<n/><n/><c val="FF8040">完成挑战3"战火兄弟"后解锁。</c>

Mengsk's Garrisons automatically train and replenish groups of basic infantry.<n/><n/>Royal Barracks, Factories, and Starports grant access to Royal Guard units, which cost large amounts of gas, but gain power as they level up.<n/><n/>Thrall Hatcheries produce enthralled Zerg units, which are AI-controlled.<n/><n/>Finally, he has access to a variety of powerful super-units.<n/><n/><c val="FF8040">Unlocked by beating Challenge 3 - Brothers in Arms.</c>

Spawn Location is self-explanatory. Dropoff Location is where the wave gathers and fliers move toward. Dropoff Region is the area transports will randomly unload inside.

Zerg unit research structures now spawn uncontrollable friendly units who will attack enemies on their own. These units benefit from mutations and weapon/armor upgrades, but not evolutions. They do not consume supply or resources, but die after 90 seconds.<n/><n/>Spawning Pools - 2 Zerglings every 15 seconds<n/>Baneling Nests - 1 Baneling every 25 seconds<n/>Roach Warrens - 1 Roach every 30 seconds<n/>Hydralisk Dens - 1 Hydralisk every 30 seconds<n/>Spires - 1 Mutalisk every 45 seconds<n/>Infestation Pits - 1 Swarm Host every 60 seconds<n/>Ultralisk Caverns - 1 Ultralisk every 90 seconds<n/><n/>Your primary Hatchery will also spawn a free Overseer with timed life every 60 seconds.

因陀罗变种雷兽每隔几秒会产生电磁脉冲，将附近所有非英雄地面单位拉向自身。它们擅长扰乱敌军阵型。

<s val="Coop_Prestige_Tooltip">MISSION TIPS</s><n/>The Dominion will attack you with everything they have. They will defend and rebuild their outposts, and synchronize attacks on you.<n/><n/>Try to stabilize your backline early, coordinating with Dehaka and Zagara as possible.<n/><n/>Consider using base defenses to hold off waves while your army is busy elsewhere.

Dogs of War units benefit from your chosen mutations, but not evolutions.

definitions.tooltipZh: 普罗米修斯连队的攻击会使目标覆盖燃烧废料，造成8点/秒伤害。<n/><n/>敌人在燃烧状态下死亡时会爆炸，对小范围内造成伤害。

localizations.value: 普罗米修斯连队的攻击会使目标覆盖燃烧废料，造成8点/秒伤害。<n/><n/>敌人在燃烧状态下死亡时会爆炸，对小范围内造成伤害。
Burning sludge coats targets of Prometheus Company's attacks, dealing 8 damage per second.<n/><n/>If enemies die while burning, they explode, dealing damage in a small area.
This structure is in an accelerated state.

definitions.tooltipZh: 星灵为什么要帮凯瑞甘，别想太多

localizations.value: 星灵为什么要帮凯瑞甘，别想太多
It's probably better if you don't think too hard about why Protoss are helping the Queen of Blades.
提升所有神族单位和建筑的护盾值。
Upgrades the shields of all Protoss units and structures.

definitions.tooltipZh: 制造聚焦灵能爆炸，对目标区域内所有敌人造成<d ref="Effect,MindBlast,Amount"/>点伤害并眩晕。

localizations.value: 制造聚焦灵能爆炸，对目标区域内所有敌人造成<d ref="Effect,MindBlast,Amount"/>点伤害并眩晕。
Deals <d ref="Effect,MindBlast,Amount"/> damage to all enemies in the target area and stuns for 3 seconds.
共振增幅线圈，能向大范围卡拉网络灌注灵能强化神族战士。
A resonant cascade coil that floods psionic energy into the Khala within a wide area, reinforcing Protoss warriors.

definitions.tooltipZh: 10码内友军技能冷却和能量恢复速度提升20%（每级+15%）。

localizations.value: 10码内友军技能冷却和能量恢复速度提升20%（每级+15%）。
Allies within 10 range gain +20% (+15%/level) ability cooldown and energy regeneration rate.
该单位技能与能量恢复速度提高15%。
This unit recharges abilities and energy 15% faster.
该单位技能与能量恢复速度提高30%。
10码内友军技能与能量恢复速度提升35%。
This unit recharges abilities and energy 30% faster.
Allies within 10 range gain +35% ability and energy recharge rates.
该单位技能与能量恢复速度提高45%。
10码内友军技能与能量恢复速度提升50%。
This unit recharges abilities and energy 45% faster.
Allies within 10 range gain +50% ability and energy recharge rates.

definitions.tooltipZh: 混合体支配者使附近友军能量恢复+1/秒。

localizations.value: 混合体支配者使附近友军能量恢复+1/秒。
The Hybrid Dominator grants nearby allies +1 energy regeneration per second.

definitions.tooltipZh: 幻影单位能量恢复极快，停止使用能量5秒后每秒恢复<c val="f078ff"><d ref="Unit,Mesmer,EnergyRegenRate)" precision="1"/></c>点能量。

localizations.value: 幻影单位能量恢复极快，停止使用能量5秒后每秒恢复<c val="f078ff"><d ref="Unit,Mesmer,EnergyRegenRate)" precision="1"/></c>点能量。
Mesmbers rapidly regenerate energy, gaining <c val="f078ff"><d ref="Unit,Mesmer,EnergyRegenRate)" precision="1"/></c> energy per second after 5 seconds of not using energy.
释放一股向外辐射的灵能爆发，击退敌人，造成 <d ref="Effect,PsionicShockwaveSpellDamage,Amount"/> 点伤害并短暂眩晕他们。
Releases a burst of psionic energy radiating outward, knocking away enemies, dealing <d ref="Effect,PsionicShockwaveSpellDamage,Amount"/> damage, and stunning them momentarily.

definitions.tooltipZh: 卡拉斯召唤灵能风暴，3.5秒内造成<d ref="(Effect,KarassPsiStormPersistent,PeriodCount) * Effect,KarassPsiStormDamage,Amount + Effect,KarassPsiStormDamageInitial,Amount"/>点伤害，范围比普通灵能风暴大50%，不会伤害友军。

localizations.value: 卡拉斯召唤灵能风暴，3.5秒内造成<d ref="(Effect,KarassPsiStormPersistent,PeriodCount) * Effect,KarassPsiStormDamage,Amount + Effect,KarassPsiStormDamageInitial,Amount"/>点伤害，范围比普通灵能风暴大50%，不会伤害友军。

Karass summons a tempest of psionic energy that deals <d ref="(Effect,KarassPsiStormPersistent,PeriodCount) * Effect,KarassPsiStormDamage,Amount + Effect,KarassPsiStormDamageInitial,Amount"/> damage over 3.5 seconds. +50% radius over a normal Psi-Storm. Does not damage allies.

definitions.tooltipZh: 术士优先消耗能量值承受伤害（1:1转换率），拥有2点不可升级的能量护甲。

localizations.value: 术士优先消耗能量值承受伤害（1:1转换率），拥有2点不可升级的能量护甲。
Warlocks take damage to energy before life, at a 1:1 ratio. They have 2 energy armor that cannot be upgraded.

definitions.tooltipZh: 攻击对前方扇形区域造成伤害。

localizations.value: 攻击对前方扇形区域造成伤害。
Attacks deal damage in a frontal arc.

definitions.tooltipZh: 这些穿甲脊针对重甲单位额外造成4点伤害。

localizations.value: 这些穿甲脊针对重甲单位额外造成4点伤害。
These armor-piercing spines deal +4 damage against Armored targets.

获得 <d ref="Behavior,PurificationNovaSpeedBoost,Modification.MoveSpeedBonus/Unit,Disruptor,Speed*100"/>% 的移动速度提升，随后在 <d ref="Behavior,PurificationNova,Duration"/> 秒后释放出强大的新星，对附近的敌人造成 <d ref="Effect,PurificationNovaDamage,Amount"/> 点溅射伤害。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">仅对地面单位和建筑造成伤害。</c>

Gains <d ref="Behavior,PurificationNovaSpeedBoost,Modification.MoveSpeedBonus/Unit,Disruptor,Speed*100"/>% increased movement speed and then after <d ref="Behavior,PurificationNova,Duration"/> seconds emits a powerful nova dealing <d ref="Effect,PurificationNovaDamage,Amount"/> splash damage to nearby enemies.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Damages ground units and structures only.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 释放一个持续 <d ref="Behavior,PurificationNovaTargettedTarget,Duration"/> 秒的能量球，该球体释放出强大的能量新星，对附近的敌人造成 <d ref="Effect,PurificationNovaDamage,Amount"/> 点溅射伤害和额外的 <d ref="Effect,PurificationNovaDamage,ShieldBonus"/> 点护盾伤害。<n/><n/>施法者在技能激活期间无法移动，但可以使用其他技能。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">仅对地面单位和建筑造成伤害。</c>

localizations.value: 释放一个持续 <d ref="Behavior,PurificationNovaTargettedTarget,Duration"/> 秒的能量球，该球体释放出强大的能量新星，对附近的敌人造成 <d ref="Effect,PurificationNovaDamage,Amount"/> 点溅射伤害和额外的 <d ref="Effect,PurificationNovaDamage,ShieldBonus"/> 点护盾伤害。<n/><n/>施法者在技能激活期间无法移动，但可以使用其他技能。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">仅对地面单位和建筑造成伤害。</c>

Shoots out a ball of energy that lasts <d ref="Behavior,PurificationNovaTargettedTarget,Duration"/> seconds and emits a powerful nova dealing <d ref="Effect,PurificationNovaDamage,Amount"/> splash damage and an additional <d ref="Effect,PurificationNovaDamage,ShieldBonus"/> shield damage to nearby enemies.<n/><n/>The Disruptor is immobile while this is active, but can use its other ability.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Damages ground units and structures only.</c>

释放一个能量球，持续 <d ref="Behavior,PurificationNovaTargettedTarget,Duration"/> 秒，并释放出强大的能量新星，对附近的地面单位和建筑造成 <d ref="Effect,PurificationNovaDamage,Amount"/> 点溅射伤害以及额外的 <d ref="Effect,PurificationNovaDamage,ShieldBonus"/> 点护盾伤害。在技能持续期间，干扰者无法移动。

Shoots out a ball of energy that lasts <d ref="Behavior,PurificationNovaTargettedTarget,Duration"/> seconds and emits a powerful nova dealing <d ref="Effect,PurificationNovaDamage,Amount"/> splash damage and an additional <d ref="Effect,PurificationNovaDamage,ShieldBonus"/> shield damage to nearby ground units and structures. The Disruptor is immobile while this is active.

definitions.tooltipZh: 召唤两台对生物特效的远程单位，有着优秀的机动性<n/><n/><c val="FFFF8A">可攻击地面单位。</c>

localizations.value: 召唤两台对生物特效的远程单位，有着优秀的机动性<n/><n/><c val="FFFF8A">可攻击地面单位。</c>
Summons 2 mobile, anti-biological ranged units with excellent mobility.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground and air units.</c>
高护甲、高生命值且具备恢复能力与范围伤害的强化跳虫。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面单位。</c>
A durable Zergling strain with high armor, life, regeneration, and area damage.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground units.</c>
拥有超强范围伤害的战场控制单位。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面单位。</c>
Powerful battlefield controller with massive area damage.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 魔能在遭受攻击时可暂时脱离现实空间，获得2秒隐形且不可侦测状态。<n/><n/>冷却时间15秒。

localizations.value: 魔能在遭受攻击时可暂时脱离现实空间，获得2秒隐形且不可侦测状态。<n/><n/>冷却时间15秒。
Fiends can phase out of realspace when attacked, gaining Cloak and Undetectable for 2 seconds.<n/><n/>Can only occur once every 15 seconds.

definitions.tooltipZh: 使友军单位视野增加<d ref="Behavior,QueenClassicParasite,Modification.SightBonus"/>，并在<d ref="Behavior,QueenClassicParasite,Duration"/>秒内获得反隐能力。

localizations.value: 使友军单位视野增加<d ref="Behavior,QueenClassicParasite,Modification.SightBonus"/>，并在<d ref="Behavior,QueenClassicParasite,Duration"/>秒内获得反隐能力。

Increases a friendly unit's sight range by <d ref="Behavior,QueenClassicParasite,Modification.SightBonus"/> and grants it the ability to detect cloaked and burrowed units for <d ref="Behavior,QueenClassicParasite,Duration"/> seconds.
飞行支援单位。可以使用诱捕，生成巢虫和感染指挥中心
Support flyer. Can use Ensnare, Spawn Broodlings, and Infest Command Center.

localizations.value: 女王诱捕导弹(多人模式)

definitions.tooltipZh: 对目标敌人造成<d ref="Effect,BroodQueenSpawnBroodlingsDamage,Amount"/>点伤害，该单位死亡时会从其尸体孵化<d ref="Effect,QueenStukovSpawnBroodlingsCreateUnit,SpawnCount"/>只巢虫。<n/><n/>会自动对最大生命/护盾≥150的目标施放。

localizations.value: 对目标敌人造成<d ref="Effect,BroodQueenSpawnBroodlingsDamage,Amount"/>点伤害，该单位死亡时会从其尸体孵化<d ref="Effect,QueenStukovSpawnBroodlingsCreateUnit,SpawnCount"/>只巢虫。<n/><n/>会自动对最大生命/护盾≥150的目标施放。

Deals <d ref="Effect,BroodQueenSpawnBroodlingsDamage,Amount"/> damage to a target enemy unit. When the unit dies, it will spawn <d ref="Effect,QueenStukovSpawnBroodlingsCreateUnit,SpawnCount"/> Broodlings from its corpse.<n/><n/>Will autocast on targets with 150+ max life or shields.

definitions.tooltipZh: 天空之怒机甲驾驶员训练有素，能以极快速度完成机甲变形。

localizations.value: 天空之怒机甲驾驶员训练有素，能以极快速度完成机甲变形。
Sky Fury pilots are exceptionally well trained, and can transform their mech at record speeds.

definitions.tooltipZh: 该单位攻击会使生物目标感染辐射，短时间内造成1点/秒伤害。<n/><n/>该效果可叠加刷新，单个单位最多累积10层。

localizations.value: 该单位攻击会使生物目标感染辐射，短时间内造成1点/秒伤害。<n/><n/>该效果可叠加刷新，单个单位最多累积10层。
This unit's basic attacks irradiate Biological targets, dealing 1 damage per second for a short time.<n/><n/>This effect can stack and refresh up to 10 times on a single unit.
该单位正受到辐射中毒伤害。
Radiation poisoning is damaging this unit.

definitions.tooltipZh: 该脊针爬虫现在可用普通攻击对空，拔地状态下依然有效。

localizations.value: 该脊针爬虫现在可用普通攻击对空，拔地状态下依然有效。
This Spine Crawler can now attack air units with its basic attack. This still works while uprooted.
射程极远但脆弱的爆发型步兵。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>
Fragile, long-range infantry with excellent burst damage.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground and air units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 该要塞会自动训练并维持最多4名游骑兵。游骑兵是射程优秀但脆弱的狙击手。<n/><n/>每名消耗<d ref="Unit,Ranger,CostResource[Minerals]"/>晶体矿。

localizations.value: 该要塞会自动训练并维持最多4名游骑兵。游骑兵是射程优秀但脆弱的狙击手。<n/><n/>每名消耗<d ref="Unit,Ranger,CostResource[Minerals]"/>晶体矿。

Garrisons will automatically train and maintain 4 more Rangers. Rangers are fragile sharpshooters with excellent range and burst damage.<n/><n/>They cost <d ref="Unit,Ranger,CostResource[Minerals]"/> minerals each.
巢虫孵化速度提升33%，存活时间延长33%。
Locusts spawn 33% faster and live 33% longer.

definitions.tooltipZh: 天罚行者的充能时间显著缩短（与合作模式不同，不会提升整体攻击速度）。.

localizations.value: 天罚行者的充能时间显著缩短（与合作模式不同，不会提升整体攻击速度）。.
The charge time of Wrathwalkers is significantly reduced. Unlike coop, this does not improve overall attack speed.
蟑螂每秒恢复2点生命值，埋地时提升至5点/秒。
Roaches constantly regenerate 2 life per second, increased to 5/sec while burrowed.

definitions.tooltipZh: 辅液技能消耗降低50%，冷却时间缩短33%。

localizations.value: 辅液技能消耗降低50%，冷却时间缩短33%。
Transfusion cost reduced by 50% and cooldown reduced by 33%.

definitions.tooltipZh: 向目标区域发射导弹，命中时对范围内所有单位造成<d ref="Effect,RavagerCorrosiveBileDamage,Amount"/>点伤害。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可摧毁神族力场。</c>

localizations.value: 向目标区域发射导弹，命中时对范围内所有单位造成<d ref="Effect,RavagerCorrosiveBileDamage,Amount"/>点伤害。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可摧毁神族力场。</c>

Launch a missile at the target location, dealing <d ref="Effect,RavagerCorrosiveBileDamage,Amount"/> damage to all units in the area upon impact.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can destroy Protoss Force Fields.</c>
该单位近期被肆虐感染侵蚀。
This unit was recently infected by Ravaging Infestation.

definitions.tooltipZh: 雷诺是指挥官型单位，拥有强大技能但冷却时间长且基础攻击较弱。

localizations.value: 雷诺是指挥官型单位，拥有强大技能但冷却时间长且基础攻击较弱。
Raynor is a commander with powerful abilities, but long cooldowns and relatively weak attacks.

definitions.tooltipZh: 该要塞产出的步兵将重新转为手动控制。

localizations.value: 该要塞产出的步兵将重新转为手动控制。
Infantry spawned from this garrison will once again fall under manual command.

definitions.tooltipZh: 掠夺者移动速度更快，可携带更多甲虫且甲虫重建速度更快。

localizations.value: 掠夺者移动速度更快，可携带更多甲虫且甲虫重建速度更快。
Reavers move faster, can carry more Scarabs, and rebuild Scarabs faster.

definitions.tooltipZh: 传送所有范围内的友方单位到主脑所在地

localizations.value: 传送所有范围内的友方单位到主脑所在地
Teleports all friendly units in the target area to the location of the Mastermind.

definitions.tooltipZh: 该要塞将停止自动训练火焰兵。

localizations.value: 该要塞将停止自动训练火焰兵。
This garrison will no longer add to your Firebat cap.

definitions.tooltipZh: 该要塞将停止自动训练幽灵。

localizations.value: 该要塞将停止自动训练幽灵。
This garrison will no longer add to your Ghost cap.

definitions.tooltipZh: 该要塞将停止自动训练劫掠者。

localizations.value: 该要塞将停止自动训练劫掠者。
This garrison will no longer add to your Marauder cap.

definitions.tooltipZh: 该要塞将停止自动训练陆战队员。

localizations.value: 该要塞将停止自动训练陆战队员。
This garrison will no longer add to your Marine cap.

definitions.tooltipZh: 该要塞将停止自动训练医疗兵。

localizations.value: 该要塞将停止自动训练医疗兵。
This garrison will no longer add to your Medics cap.

definitions.tooltipZh: 该要塞将停止自动训练游骑兵。

localizations.value: 该要塞将停止自动训练游骑兵。
This garrison will no longer add to your Ranger cap.
定期生成次级原始异虫。

definitions.tooltipZh: 该单位脱离战斗5秒后，每秒恢复5点生命值。

localizations.value: 该单位脱离战斗5秒后，每秒恢复5点生命值。
This unit regenerates 5 life per second if it has been out of combat for at least 5 seconds.

definitions.tooltipZh: 跳虫、陆战队员、狂热者等指挥官单位死亡时返还20%造价。

localizations.value: 跳虫、陆战队员、狂热者等指挥官单位死亡时返还20%造价。
Zerglings, Marines, Zealots, and similar commander units now refund 20% of their cost on death.
蒙斯克精英卫队的悬浮坦克，移动射击且伤害极高。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面单位。</c>
Fast, high-damage hovertank. Rail gun can fire while the Red Adder is moving. Part of Mengsk's elite guard.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground units.</c>
Despite diligent maintenance, Tyrador IX's refineries have reported lower-than-average vespene yields since the Cerberus attack, as if the underground reservoirs they tap have been diverted.
Despite diligent maintenance, Tyrador IX's refineries have reported lower-than-average vespene yields since the Cerberus attack, as if the underground reservoirs they tap have been diverted.

definitions.tooltipZh: 该单位拥有异常迅速的生命恢复能力。

localizations.value: 该单位拥有异常迅速的生命恢复能力。
This unit regenerates life abnormally quickly.
在混合体巨兽附近时，生命恢复+3。
+3 life regeneration while close to a Hybrid Behemoth.

definitions.tooltipZh: 雷诺的载具和地堡脱离战斗3秒后，每秒恢复2点生命值。<n/><n/>毕竟雷诺玩过《自由之翼》，还记得怎么用研发界面。

localizations.value: 雷诺的载具和地堡脱离战斗3秒后，每秒恢复2点生命值。<n/><n/>毕竟雷诺玩过《自由之翼》，还记得怎么用研发界面。
Raynor's vehicles and bunkers regenerate 2 life/sec after 3 seconds out of combat.<n/><n/>Raynor played Wings of Liberty+ and remembered how to use the Research tab.
该单位每秒恢复30点生命值。
This unit regenerates 30 life per second.

definitions.tooltipZh: 10码内友方单位脱离战斗后，每秒恢复4点生命值与4点护盾值。

localizations.value: 脱离战斗时，该单位每秒恢复4点生命值与护盾值。
10码内友方单位脱离战斗后，每秒恢复4点生命值与4点护盾值。
This unit is regenerating 4 life and shields per second while out of combat.
Friendly units in 10 range regenerate 4 life and 4 shields per second while outside of combat.

definitions.tooltipZh: 修复机械单位与建筑，不消耗资源。

localizations.value: 修复机械单位与建筑，不消耗资源。
Restores life to mechanical units and structures. Does not cost resources.
可暂时变形为敌方单位的特殊功能体。<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">可攻击地面单位。</c>
Esoteric utility unit. Can transform into target enemy unit temporarily, allowing them to fill a wide variety of roles.<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">Can attack ground units.</c>

Bulky frontliners that grow more dangerous when attacked.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 支援单位，能造成中等伤害、侦测隐形并治疗生物友军。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>

localizations.value: 支援单位，能造成中等伤害、侦测隐形并治疗生物友军。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>
Support unit that deals moderate damage, detects, and heals Biological allies.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground and air units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 召唤2台拥有强化射程和伤害的对地飞行单位。女妖可潜地快读回复生命和能量<n/><n/><c val="FFFF8A">可攻击地面单位。</c>

localizations.value: 召唤2台拥有强化射程和伤害的对地飞行单位。女妖可潜地快读回复生命和能量<n/><n/><c val="FFFF8A">可攻击地面单位。</c>
Summons 2 anti-ground fliers with enhanced range and damage. Infested Banshees can Burrow to rapidly regain Life and Energy.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 可折跃强大的混合体单位。

localizations.value: 可折跃强大的混合体单位。
Can warp in powerful Hybrid units.

definitions.tooltipZh: 卡拉克斯是一名辅助型英雄，能施放强力的灵能风暴（不会伤害友军），并为附近友军恢复护盾。

localizations.value: 卡拉克斯是一名辅助型英雄，能施放强力的灵能风暴（不会伤害友军），并为附近友军恢复护盾。
Karass is a support hero who can cast powerful Psi-Storms, which do not damage allies, as well as restore the shields of nearby allies.

definitions.tooltipZh: 坚硬，短射程的施法者，拥有数种干扰技能<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">可对地对空</c>

localizations.value: 坚硬，短射程的施法者，拥有数种干扰技能<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">可对地对空</c>
Durable, short-ranged caster with a variety of disruptive abilities.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground and air units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 支援单位，可传送友军，支配敌人<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">无法攻击但会和敌人保持距离.</c>

localizations.value: 支援单位，可传送友军，支配敌人<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">无法攻击但会和敌人保持距离.</c>
Support caster that can teleport allies around the battlefield and dominate enemies.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Cannot attack, but stays at range from enemies</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 从下方矿脉中提取矿物。<n/><n/>该建筑占用<d ref="(Unit,MatterConversionField,Food) * (-1)"/>人口，矿物产量约等于2个工人。

localizations.value: 从下方矿脉中提取矿物。<n/><n/>该建筑占用<d ref="(Unit,MatterConversionField,Food) * (-1)"/>人口，矿物产量约等于2个工人。
Extracts minerals from the field beneath.<n/><n/>This structure uses <d ref="(Unit,MatterConversionField,Food) * (-1)"/> supply, and produces minerals at a similar rate as 2 workers.

definitions.tooltipZh: 莫比斯军团的核心生产建筑。莫比斯单位类型多样，多数适合与其他兵种配合作战而非单一量产。

localizations.value: 莫比斯军团的核心生产建筑。莫比斯单位类型多样，多数适合与其他兵种配合作战而非单一量产。
Core Moebius production structure. Moebius units vary wildly, and many work best with other units rather than massed.

definitions.tooltipZh: 纳克图尔是一名辅助型英雄单位，能为友军提供增益并快速补充部队。<n/><n/>其伤害输出与跳虫相当。

localizations.value: 纳克图尔是一名辅助型英雄单位，能为友军提供增益并快速补充部队。<n/><n/>其伤害输出与跳虫相当。
Naktul is a supportive hero unit that can buff allies and rapidly replenish your forces.<n/><n/>She does about the same DPS as a Zergling.

definitions.tooltipZh: 坑道毁灭者是强力多功能的防御型"建筑"，但耐久度不如脊针爬虫。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>

localizations.value: 坑道毁灭者是强力多功能的防御型"建筑"，但耐久度不如脊针爬虫。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>
Nydus Destroyers are powerful and versatile defensive 'structures', but not as durable as Crawlers.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Attacks ground and air units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 菌毯塔能持续向指定方向蔓延菌毯，是理想的通道建造者。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">加成：虫族单位在菌毯上移动更快。</c>

localizations.value: 菌毯塔能持续向指定方向蔓延菌毯，是理想的通道建造者。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">加成：虫族单位在菌毯上移动更快。</c>
Creep Towers constantly launch creep in a chosen direction, making for excellent pathways.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Bonus: Zerg move faster on creep.</c>
友方地面单位可通过坑道虫瞬间传送到玩家拥有的任意其他坑道虫或坑道网络中。生成大片菌毯并侦测隐形单位。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">加成：虫族单位在菌毯上移动更快。</c>

Friendly ground units can use a Nydus Worm to instantly travel to any other Nydus Worm or Nydus Network owned by the player. Grants a large area of creep and detects cloaked enemies.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Bonus: Zerg move faster on creep.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 召唤巨型攻城构造体，对单一目标造成递增伤害。<n/><n/>与裂隙中大多数单位不同，该单位不由AI控制。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>

localizations.value: 召唤巨型攻城构造体，对单一目标造成递增伤害。<n/><n/>与裂隙中大多数单位不同，该单位不由AI控制。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>

Summons a massive siege construct that deals scaling damage to a single target.<n/><n/>Unlike most things in the rift, this is not AI controlled.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground and air units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 发射造成小额范围伤害并眩晕的能量球，还能（缓慢地）治疗附近友军。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面单位。</c>

localizations.value: 发射造成小额范围伤害并眩晕的能量球，还能（缓慢地）治疗附近友军。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面单位。</c>
Launches orbs that deal minor area damage and stun. Can also heal nearby allied units (slowly).<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 折跃在瓦斯气泉上以采集高能瓦斯。

localizations.value: 折跃在瓦斯气泉上以采集高能瓦斯。
Warped in over a Vespene Geyser to allow harvesting of vespene gas.

definitions.tooltipZh: 召唤对建筑有着优秀伤害的长距离攻城单位。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>

localizations.value: 召唤对建筑有着优秀伤害的长距离攻城单位。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>
Calls in a long-ranged siege unit with excellent damage against Structures.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground and air units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 沃菲尔德的旗舰，一艘火力与耐久度都登峰造极的战列巡航舰。同时只能存在一艘。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>

localizations.value: 沃菲尔德的旗舰，一艘火力与耐久度都登峰造极的战列巡航舰。同时只能存在一艘。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>
Warfield's flagship, a massive battlecruiser with supreme firepower and durability. Can only have one at a time.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground and air units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 向随机目标发动暴雨般的攻击。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>

localizations.value: 向随机目标发动暴雨般的攻击。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>
Fires a storm of attacks at random targets.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground and air units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 召唤斯图科夫，一名专注于召唤、减益和光环的辅助型英雄。

localizations.value: 召唤斯图科夫，一名专注于召唤、减益和光环的辅助型英雄。
Summons Stukov, a supportive hero who focuses on summons, debuffs, and auras.

definitions.tooltipZh: 塔达林的核心生产建筑。多数塔达林单位伤害惊人但生存能力较弱。

localizations.value: 塔达林的核心生产建筑。多数塔达林单位伤害惊人但生存能力较弱。
Core Tal'darim production structure. Most Tal'darim units have excellent damage, but lack survivability.

definitions.tooltipZh: 伊罕-瑞的核心生产建筑。多数单位在伤害与生存能力间保持良好平衡。

localizations.value: 伊罕-瑞的核心生产建筑。多数单位在伤害与生存能力间保持良好平衡。
Core Ihan-Rii production structure. Most units have a good balance of damage and survivability.

definitions.tooltipZh: 发射强力的单体光束。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>

localizations.value: 发射强力的单体光束。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>
Fires a powerful single-target beam.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground and air units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 托许擅长锁定危险目标并控制敌群，能在战斗中自由调整站位。

localizations.value: 托许擅长锁定危险目标并控制敌群，能在战斗中自由调整站位。
Tosh excels at singling out dangerous foes and crowd controlling enemies. He can reposition freely during battle.

definitions.tooltipZh: 召唤AI控制的虚空之影。可设置为免费缓慢生成，或消耗资源快速组建大军。

localizations.value: 召唤AI控制的虚空之影。可设置为免费缓慢生成，或消耗资源快速组建大军。
Summons AI-controlled Void shades. Can be set to slowly spawn then for free, or create much larger forces for a cost.

definitions.tooltipZh: 高耐久的前线英雄，拥有强悍的近战伤害、再生能力和减速光环。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面单位。</c>

localizations.value: 高耐久的前线英雄，拥有强悍的近战伤害、再生能力和减速光环。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面单位。</c>
Durable frontline hero with high melee damage, regeneration, and a slowing aura.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 扎加拉擅长召唤护卫单位保护自己并激励友军进攻，同时具备可观的伤害输出。.

localizations.value: 扎加拉擅长召唤护卫单位保护自己并激励友军进攻，同时具备可观的伤害输出。.
Zagara excels at summoning bodyguard units to protect herself and keeping allies on the offense. She deals decent damage as well.

definitions.tooltipZh: 泽拉图是一名均衡型英雄，永久隐形，擅长在危机中进退自如。

localizations.value: 泽拉图是一名均衡型英雄，永久隐形，擅长在危机中进退自如。
Zeratul is a versatile hero, permanently cloaked, who excels at getting in and out of trouble.

definitions.tooltipZh: 战地豪猪使用梅利祖传梅氏老方的兴奋剂，提升25%攻击和移动速度且不消耗生命值。

localizations.value: 该单位在兴奋剂效果期间移动与攻击速度提升。
战地豪猪使用梅利祖传梅氏老方的兴奋剂，提升25%攻击和移动速度且不消耗生命值。
This unit moves and attacks more quickly while under the effects of Stimpack.
War Pigs use a special blend of stimulants that increase attack and movement speed by 25% without costing life.

definitions.tooltipZh: 将德哈卡的自然生命恢复从2提升至4，并获得50%法术抗性。

localizations.value: 将德哈卡的自然生命恢复从2提升至4，并获得50%法术抗性。
Doubles Dehaka's natural life regeneration from 2 to 4 and grants 50% spell resist.

definitions.tooltipZh: 将造成伤害的25%转化为生命恢复。

localizations.value: 将造成伤害的25%转化为生命恢复。
Regains 25% of damage dealt as life.

definitions.tooltipZh: 斯旺可以修理友方机械单位，并召唤一座相对强力的炮台。

localizations.value: 斯旺可以修理友方机械单位，并召唤一座相对强力的炮台。
Swann can repair allied mechanical units and summon a relatively powerful turret.

definitions.tooltipZh: 换装飞鹰导弹，以高密度齐射造成巨额伤害。

localizations.value: 换装飞鹰导弹，以高密度齐射造成巨额伤害。
Load Sparrow missiles, which fire in large bursts for high damage.

definitions.tooltipZh: 换装黄蜂导弹，使敌人减速25%并额外承受25%伤害，但自身伤害显著降低。

localizations.value: 换装黄蜂导弹，使敌人减速25%并额外承受25%伤害，但自身伤害显著降低。
Load Wasp missiles, which slow enemies by 25% and increase their damage taken by 25%, but deal significantly less damage.
攻城单位，通过召唤蝗虫作战。可在地下或移动时攻击。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">蝗虫可攻击地面单位。</c>
Siege unit that attacks by spawning Locust minions. Can attack while burrowed or mobile.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Locusts can attack ground units.</c>
通过召唤蝗虫攻击的攻城单位。能使用深坑道技能并在潜伏时生成菌毯。<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">蝗虫可攻击地面单位。</c>
Siege unit that attacks by spawning Locusts. Can use the Deep Tunnel ability and generate creep while burrowed.<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">Locusts can attack ground units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 吸血鬼将扑向附近的地面目标。<n/><n/>仅当周围无空中敌人且存在地面目标时会自动施放，但可手动强制指令。

localizations.value: 吸血鬼将扑向附近的地面目标。<n/><n/>仅当周围无空中敌人且存在地面目标时会自动施放，但可手动强制指令。
The Vampire will hurl itself at a nearby ground target.<n/><n/>Will not autocast unless there are zero aerial enemies nearby AND at least one ground foe, but you can manually order it regardless.

definitions.tooltipZh: 生物目标将同时遭受神经与DNA退化，最终沦为无意识的粘液。每秒造成1点伤害，最多可叠加50层。

localizations.value: 生物目标将同时遭受神经与DNA退化，最终沦为无意识的粘液。每秒造成1点伤害，最多可叠加50层。
Biological targets undergo simultaneous neural and DNA degradation, devolving into little more than mindless sludge given time. Deals 1 damage per second, and can stack up to 50 times.

definitions.tooltipZh: 术士拥有大范围侦测能力和极佳视野。

localizations.value: 术士拥有大范围侦测能力和极佳视野。
Warlocks can detect in a large range and have excellent vision.

definitions.tooltipZh: 巢虫获得+30生命值。此效果适用于所有巢虫。<n/><n/>守护者每次对地攻击时，攻击速度提升20%，最高可达60%。<n/><n/>吞噬者现在减少攻击速度和护甲的速度是原来的两倍。<n/><n/>克拉肯失去1点射程，但每次齐射多发射2枚导弹。

localizations.value: 巢虫获得+30生命值。此效果适用于所有巢虫。<n/><n/>守护者每次对地攻击时，攻击速度提升20%，最高可达60%。<n/><n/>吞噬者现在减少攻击速度和护甲的速度是原来的两倍。<n/><n/>克拉肯失去1点射程，但每次齐射多发射2枚导弹。

Broodlings gain +30 health. This works on ALL Broodlings.<n/><n/>Guardians gain 20% attack speed with each ground attack, up to 60% total.<n/><n/>Devourers now reduce attack speed and armor twice as fast.<n/><n/>Krakens lose 1 range, but fire 2 additional missiles per volley.

definitions.tooltipZh: 区域内目标显形并承受15%额外伤害，被皇家卫队击杀时提供2点额外经验值。<n/><n/>持续<d ref="Behavior,Targeted,Duration"/>秒。

localizations.value: 区域内目标显形并承受15%额外伤害，被皇家卫队击杀时提供2点额外经验值。<n/><n/>持续<d ref="Behavior,Targeted,Duration"/>秒。
Targets in the area are revealed, take 15% more damage, and grant 2 bonus experience to Royal Guard in the area when killed.<n/><n/>Lasts for <d ref="Behavior,Targeted,Duration"/> seconds.

definitions.tooltipZh: 吸血鬼升空，重新获得对空作战能力。<n/><n/>若处于地面形态且附近无地面目标时将自动触发。

localizations.value: 吸血鬼升空，重新获得对空作战能力。<n/><n/>若处于地面形态且附近无地面目标时将自动触发。
The Vampire takes off, allowing it to engage aerial targets again.<n/><n/>Will naturally autocast if the Vampire is groundbound with no nearby ground targets.
该单位承受伤害增加15%，死亡时使附近皇家守卫获得2点额外经验值，并暴露位置60秒。
This unit takes 15% additional damage, grants 2 bonus experience to nearby Royal Guard when it dies, and is revealed for 60 seconds.
使锁定目标额外承受<d ref="Behavior,ObserverTargetLock,Modification.DamageTakenFraction[Splash]*100"/>%伤害，效果持续至锁定解除。
Increases damage dealt to target enemy unit by <d ref="Behavior,ObserverTargetLock,Modification.DamageTakenFraction[Splash]*100"/>%. Effect lasts as long as this unit remains locked onto the target.

definitions.tooltipZh: 该单位会优先攻击重甲单位。

localizations.value: 该单位会优先攻击重甲单位。
This unit will target Armored units first where reasonable.

definitions.tooltipZh: 该单位会优先攻击高生命值敌人。

localizations.value: 该单位会优先攻击高生命值敌人。
This unit will prioritize attacking enemies with high Life.

definitions.tooltipZh: 该单位会优先攻击轻甲单位。

localizations.value: 该单位会优先攻击轻甲单位。
This unit will target Light units first where reasonable.
伤害贫弱但擅长修理和部署炮台的支援型步兵。
Support infantry with poor damage, but strong repair and turret capabilities.
高机动攻击单位，伤害出色但耐久低下。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>
Fast attack unit with excellent damage, but low durability.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground and air units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 召唤2辆高机动攻击载具，具备卓越的单体伤害。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>

localizations.value: 召唤2辆高机动攻击载具，具备卓越的单体伤害。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>
Calls in 2 fast attack vehicles with excellent single-target damage..<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground and air units.</c>
耐久型支援单位，能剥离敌方护盾并治疗机械友军。
Durable support unit that can strip shields from foes and heal Mechanical allies.

definitions.tooltipZh: 擅长对抗巨型单位和建筑的远程攻城舰。对空攻击射程较短且威力较弱。<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>

localizations.value: 擅长对抗巨型单位和建筑的远程攻城舰。对空攻击射程较短且威力较弱。<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>

Matriarchs are durable and deal good damage in melee. They can jump up and down cliffs.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground units.</c>

Elite infantry that use energy for damage and shielding.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground and air units.</c>

localizations.value: 精英施法者，拥有多种强力技能且能量恢复速度快。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>
Elite caster with a variety of powerful abilities and high energy regeneration.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground and air units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 将混合体支配者传送至附近位置。

localizations.value: 将混合体支配者传送至附近位置。
Teleports the Hybrid Dominator to a nearby location.

definitions.tooltipZh: 人口消耗从2降低至1，且建造成本减半。

localizations.value: 人口消耗从2降低至1，且建造成本减半。
Supply Cost reduced from 2 to 1, and construction cost halved.

localizations.value: 泰凯斯能对单个目标造成高持续伤害，并可投掷粉碎手雷攻击群体目标。
Tychus deals high sustained damage to single targets, and can hurl Shredder Grenades to attack groups.
该单位承受的远程伤害减少15%。
This unit takes 15% reduced Ranged damage.
使死神能够攻击空中单位，武器射程+1，对轻型单位伤害+3。
Allows Reapers to shoot air units, adds 1 range to their weapon, and increases their damage versus Light units by 3.
重型突击单位。拥有范围溅射攻击。<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">可攻击地面单位。</c>
Heavy assault unit. Has an area-damage cleave attack.<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">Can attack ground units.</c>
通用型步兵。虽不及圣骑士，但其战斗服造价仅为后者零头。<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>
General-purpose infantry. Inferior to Paladins, but their suits are a fraction of the price.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can attack ground and air units.</c>

definitions.tooltipZh: 让爆虫宿主钻出地面移动。仍可孵化爆虫。

localizations.value: 让爆虫宿主钻出地面移动。仍可孵化爆虫。
Unburrows the Bane Host to move. It can still spawn Banelings.

definitions.tooltipZh: 获得12范围的侦测能力，同时视野范围从10提升至15。

localizations.value: 获得12范围的侦测能力，同时视野范围从10提升至15。
Gains Detection with 12 range, as well as increasing sight range from 10 to 15.
该单位不受玩家控制，会主动追击敌人直至死亡。<n/><n/>注意：它们智力极低，有时需要协助处理菌毯肿瘤等目标。
This unit cannot be controlled by the player. It will seek out enemies until it dies.<n/><n/>Please note that they are extremely stupid and may need help with creep tumors and the like sometimes.

definitions.tooltipZh: 蝗虫仅会与其他蝗虫发生碰撞。

localizations.value: 蝗虫仅会与其他蝗虫发生碰撞。
Locusts do not collide with anything except for other Locusts.

This unit is immune to damage and regenerates 15 life/sec for 3 seconds.
该单位已被不朽精华复活并获得耐久强化。
This unit has been revived by Undying Essence and gained durability.
该单位近期被不朽精华复活，180秒内无法再次触发该效果。<n/><n/>其他复活效果仍可生效。
This unit has recently been revived by Undying Essence and cannot be revived by it again until 180 seconds have passed.<n/><n/>Other revives will still work.

definitions.tooltipZh: 蟑螂始终保持每秒5点的生命恢复。

localizations.value: 蟑螂始终保持每秒5点的生命恢复。
Roaches regenerate 5 life per second at all times.

definitions.tooltipZh: 穿越阴影，看似瞬间传送至附近位置。

localizations.value: 穿越阴影，看似瞬间传送至附近位置。

definitions.tooltipZh: 每项升级适用于所有单位-武器升级同时提升星灵地面/空军武器、异虫近战/远程/飞行武器、以及人类步兵/车辆/舰船武器。

localizations.value: 每项升级适用于所有单位-武器升级同时提升星灵地面/空军武器、异虫近战/远程/飞行武器、以及人类步兵/车辆/舰船武器。
Each upgrade applies to all units - weapon upgrades grants Protoss Ground/Air Weapons, Zerg Melee/Missile/Flyer Weapons, and Terran Infantry/Vehicle/Ship Weapons.
该单位处于隐形状态，无视单位碰撞体积且移动速度提升。
This unit is cloaked, does not collide with other units, and moves faster.

definitions.tooltipZh: 暴龙兽几乎免疫大多数减速和定身效果。

localizations.value: 暴龙兽几乎免疫大多数减速和定身效果。
Tyrannozaurs are nearly immune to most slow and snare effects.

definitions.tooltipZh: 使选定单位显形，对敌人可见。

localizations.value: 使选定单位显形，对敌人可见。
Decloaks the selected unit, making it visible to enemies.

definitions.tooltipZh: 提升所有单位的护甲等级。

localizations.value: 提升所有单位的护甲等级。
Upgrades the armor of all units.

definitions.tooltipZh: 进一步提升所有单位的护甲等级。

localizations.value: 进一步提升所有单位的护甲等级。
Further upgrades the armor of all units.

definitions.tooltipZh: 将所有单位的护甲等级提升至最高。

localizations.value: 将所有单位的护甲等级提升至最高。
Maximizes the armor of all units.

definitions.tooltipZh: 提升所有单位的攻击伤害。

localizations.value: 提升所有单位的攻击伤害。

definitions.tooltipZh: 进一步提升所有单位的攻击伤害。

localizations.value: 进一步提升所有单位的攻击伤害。
Further upgrades the damage dealt by all units.

localizations.value: 将所有单位的攻击伤害提升至最高。
Maximizes the damage dealt by all units.

definitions.tooltipZh: 奥莉加的荣耀可被动生成资源。由你或盟友击杀的敌人，其生命精华将转化为矿物与瓦斯返还（瓦斯效能可提升转化率）。<n/><n/>单位升级无需研究，将在第5、10、15分钟自动解锁。<n/><n/>相位模式下的折跃棱镜可折跃步兵单位，而奥莉加的荣耀可折跃星际舰船。

localizations.value: 奥莉加的荣耀可被动生成资源。由你或盟友击杀的敌人，其生命精华将转化为矿物与瓦斯返还（瓦斯效能可提升转化率）。<n/><n/>单位升级无需研究，将在第5、10、15分钟自动解锁。<n/><n/>相位模式下的折跃棱镜可折跃步兵单位，而奥莉加的荣耀可折跃星际舰船。

Powerful Dominion warship with rapid-fire laser batteries and a wave motion gun.<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">Can attack ground and air units.</c>
快速的近战飞行单位，可俯冲攻击地面目标。<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">可攻击地面和空中单位。</c>
Fast, melee flier that can swoop down to attack ground units.<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">Can attack ground and air units.</c>

This Drone gathers +1 gas from Extractors.

Sniper siege unit that attacks with hovering wasps. Rebuilds lost Vespids extremely slowly.<n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Vespids can attack ground units.</c>

Flying caster. Able to manipulate battlefield conditions. Can use Parasitic Bomb, Consume, Blinding Cloud, and Abduct abilities.

伊罕利阵营<n/>坚固的突击单位，能削弱敌人以协助友军。<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">可攻击地面单位。</c>
Ihan-Rii Faction<n/>Durable assault unit that weakens foes for allies.<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">Can attack ground units.</c>
坚固的短程突击单位。擅长撕裂装甲单位。
Durable, short-ranged assault unit. Excels at tearing apart Armored units.

definitions.tooltipZh: 用神秘的虚空水晶替换凤凰战机的离子电容器，使幻影战机的射速大幅提升.

localizations.value: 用神秘的虚空水晶替换凤凰战机的离子电容器，使幻影战机的射速大幅提升.
Swapping out the ionic capacitors of normal Phoenixes for elusive void crystals, Phantoms gain a drastically increased rate of fire.

definitions.tooltipZh: 该单位攻击时若持续锁定同一目标，每0.33秒额外造成1点伤害。

localizations.value: 该单位攻击时若持续锁定同一目标，每0.33秒额外造成1点伤害。
This unit's attacks deal an additional 1 damage every 0.33 seconds while it remains locked onto a single target.
在混合体支配者附近时，能量恢复+1。
+1 energy regeneration while close to a Hybrid Dominator.

definitions.tooltipZh: 召唤由侦察机、怨灵战机和异龙组成的混合部队。虽然听起来不怎么样，但现在侦察机和怨灵战机确实很强！<n/><n/>可设置为自动施放。

localizations.value: 召唤由侦察机、怨灵战机和异龙组成的混合部队。虽然听起来不怎么样，但现在侦察机和怨灵战机确实很强！<n/><n/>可设置为自动施放。
Summons a mixture of Scouts, Wraiths, and Mutalisks. I know this sounds awful but Scouts and Wraiths are actually good now!<n/><n/>Can be autocast.

definitions.tooltipZh: 在目标区域召唤宇宙能量团，造成<d ref="Effect,VoidMeteorDamage,Amount"/>点范围伤害。

localizations.value: 在目标区域召唤宇宙能量团，造成<d ref="Effect,VoidMeteorDamage,Amount"/>点范围伤害。
Calls down a mass of cosmic energy on the target, dealing <d ref="Effect,VoidMeteorDamage,Amount"/> damage in a small area.
能为附近友军提供隐形效果，同时像普通水晶塔一样提供人口支持。
Cloaks nearby allies and provides Supply like a normal Pylon.

definitions.tooltipZh: 5秒后摧毁该建筑。<n/><n/>不会返还任何资源。

localizations.value: 5秒后摧毁该建筑。<n/><n/>不会返还任何资源。
After 5 seconds, destroys this structure.<n/><n/>You do not receive a refund.
从虚空中召唤暗影生物和怪物。

使目标区域内敌军眩晕<d ref="Effect,VoidSentryBlackHolePersistent,PeriodCount*Effect,VoidSentryBlackHolePersistent,PeriodicPeriodArray[0]"/>秒。<n/><n/>对英雄单位无效。

该单位由虚空能量构成，易受萨尔纳加 celestial 能量影响。<n/><n/>所幸萨尔纳加凯瑞甘并非真实存在，无法伤害你。
This unit is formed from the void and is vulnerable to the celestial energies of the Xel'Naga.<n/><n/>Fortunately, Xel'Naga Kerrigan isn't real and can't hurt you.
龙骑士拥有高生命值和出色的生命值/护盾护甲。
Dragoons have high life and excellent life/shield armor.
龙骑士发射强力的反物质弹，对所有目标都有效，尤其擅长对抗装甲单位。
Dragoons launch a powerful anti-matter bolt that is good against all targets, but excels against armored foes.
目标处于灵能风暴效果范围内，滞留该区域将承受巨额伤害。
Target is under the effects of Psionic Storm and will take massive damage while in this area of effect.

definitions.tooltipZh: 虽然幻影只能攻击地面敌人，但其范围伤害可影响区域内的飞行单位。

Aiur Faction<n/>Ranged assault strider. Has enhanced life and attack damage.<n/><n/><c val="ffff8a">Can attack ground and air units.</c>
